question: Where are a café available within a 170 kilometers radius of English Street Community Garden, New Haven, CT?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin( geometry :: geography, ( SELECT P.geometry :: geography FROM parks AS P WHERE P.park_name ILIKE '%English Street Community Garden%' AND ST_Intersects( P.geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%New Haven%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 ) ) LIMIT 1 ), 170000 );
